title: Eric Haseltine's idea of a massless object
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Eric Haseltine's idea of a massless object, about 2004 at Off San Diego (Nimitz, 2004), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

plain: Podcast host Jesse Michels says that a man named Eric Haseltine raised an idea about the 2004 encounter off San Diego, where Navy pilots from the aircraft carrier Nimitz reported a strange flying object. According to Michels, Haseltine asked: what if the object had no mass at all? He pointed to the physics rule that force equals mass times acceleration, which would mean such an object could move in ways normal aircraft cannot.
